title: Conceal or advertise?
hook: Two defenses can affect detection in different ways.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: In a toy scene, one animal matches its background while another has a contrasting warning pattern. Which is harder to see against that background?

misconception: The stated evidence implies a different interpretation or a universal conclusion.
objective: In a toy scene, one animal matches its background while another has a contrasting warning pattern. Which is harder to see against that background?

claims.text: In a toy scene, one animal matches its background while another has a contrasting warning pattern. Which is harder to see against that background? The first animal is drawn with the same pattern as its background; the second has a contrasting pattern. Concealment and warning are different ideas. The toy scene shows visibility, not an actual predator’s behavior or the effectiveness of either defense.
